text.en: Raju's uncle grew vegetables in a green house and raised fish in a pond. "That is economic biology," he said.

Horticulture is the science of growing fruits, vegetables and flowers. Pomology is fruit farming, olericulture is growing vegetables, floriculture is cultivating flowering plants and landscape gardening makes gardens beautiful. Vegetable forcing grows vegetables in buildings, green houses or other artificial conditions.
Manures such as animal manure, compost and green manure improve the soil, and biofertilisers add nutrients. Medicinal plants give drugs called secondary metabolites. Mushroom cultivation, hydroponics (growing plants in water), aeroponics and aquaponics are modern methods.
Dairy farming raises cattle for milk, aquaculture raises water animals, pisciculture is fish culture, prawn culture is rearing prawns and vermiculture uses earthworms to make compost.
